title: Cisco UCS
description: A Cisco UCS Manager domain monitored by ucs-exporter.

panels.title: Domain up
panels.description: 0 if the latest poll of the domain failed.

panels.title: VIFs down
panels.description: Virtual circuits (vNIC/vHBA paths) whose link is not up.

panels.title: FC ports down
panels.description: FC ports that are not up, excluding empty SFP cages.

targets.expr: ucs_server_info{domain="$domain",server=~"$server"} * on (domain, server) group_left (org, service_profile) (ucs_server_service_profile_info{domain="$domain"} or on (domain, server) label_replace(ucs_server_info{domain="$domain"} * 0 + 1, "service_profile", "(none)", "", ""))

panels.title: Components not operable
panels.description: Every component whose operability is not 'operable': servers, CPUs, DIMMs, disks, adapters, chassis, IOMs, FEXes, FIs, PSUs, fans and fan modules.

panels.title: VLAN port usage
panels.description: VLAN port instances in use as a fraction of the platform limit.

panels.title: FI port discards and pause frames
FC CRC errors (per hour)
panels.description: SAN port channels are summed from their member ports: UCSM's own port-channel error counters occasionally report garbage values for one poll.

targets.expr: sum by (fabric, port_channel) (increase(ucs_fi_fc_port_crc_errors_total{domain="$domain"}[1h]) * on (domain, fabric, port) group_left (port_channel) group by (domain, fabric, port, port_channel) (ucs_fi_fc_port_channel_member_up{domain="$domain"})) > 0

panels.title: FC link failures, signal and sync losses (per hour)
vHBA errors (adapter side, per hour)
panels.description: Only some adapters report these; see the README.

panels.title: FC ports, SAN port channels and FCoE uplinks not up
Service profiles, vNICs and virtual circuits
Virtual circuits down
panels.description: VIFs (one per vNIC/vHBA per fabric) whose operational state is not active.

panels.title: Virtual circuit pinning
panels.description: The FI uplink port or port channel each virtual circuit is pinned to.

panels.title: IOM host ports down (with connected adapter)

targets.expr: (ucs_iom_host_port_up{domain="$domain",chassis=~"$chassis"} == 0) * on (domain, chassis, iom, port) group_left (server, adaptor, interface) ucs_iom_host_port_peer_info{domain="$domain"}

panels.title: IOM fabric port CRC errors (per hour)
Correctable ECC errors (top 10 DIMMs, per hour)

targets.expr: (ucs_server_dimm_ecc_multibit_errors_total{domain="$domain"} > 0) * on (domain, server, memory_array, dimm) group_left (location) ucs_server_dimm_info{domain="$domain"}
